title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: two packages' declared overrides of one flow or action name each serve in their own package's slot, in any registration order (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DRByc1B7Tw9zd22M7ny5NNF)_
Fixes #32613

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个包都发布了同名的流程（或动作），并且各自在自己的 `.custom` 里声明了覆盖时，以前全环境列表（`GET /meta/flow`、`GET /meta/action`、执行视图 `getMetaItemsForExecution`）会把其中一个包的覆盖再列一遍、挂在另一个包名下，结果还随包的注册先后而变；动作还会把第二个包的覆盖整个丢掉，改跑它的出厂版本；启动拉取在 `kernel:ready` 前也可能先挂上出厂流程。现在每个包的覆盖只出现一次、只挂在自己包下，注册顺序不影响答案：恰好 `alpha:OVR-A` 和 `beta:OVR-B`。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D4 / 专题 #31527 红线 2（歧义要报、不能猜）：一个包的覆盖以另一个包的名义被执行，属于运行错身体。#32552 在等本卡落地，#32820 也在等同一个热文件。
- 风险与回滚：窄化（Clause-② no (narrowing)）：全环境列表不再列出那些挂错包名的多余条目，仓内读这些条目的第一方调用方为 0；单包发布同名项、两包都没覆盖的情形均有对照测试钉住不变。本 PR 只动 flow 和 action：六个 sealed 类型、其它覆盖类型的列表条目、动作的注册表读面照 main 不变，转给 #33131。不改任何键、值或存储形状。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-lock-state.ts`（`servedOverrideOfAShipper`，动作改为对每个发布包判定）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`（多发布包时丢掉 pair 槽里的重复条目）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts` + `stored-flow-slot.ts`（启动拉取按全部发布包判定覆盖）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol-flow-custom-override.test.ts -t 32613`，预期全部通过（两种注册顺序 × flow/action，外加停用/重启用与两条对照）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Two packages, alpha and beta, ship a flow or an action of the same name `F`, and each has a declared `.custom` override bound to its own package (OVR-A, OVR-B). Before this PR the answer depended on registration order (ADR-0150 D4, epic #31527 red line 2). Three places are fixed, all in `packages/metadata-protocol`, for `flow` and `action` only (contract review 6858448985, M1 and S1):

- **The lists** (`readFlattenedMetaItems`, which serves `GET /meta/flow`, `GET /meta/action` with no package, and `getMetaItemsForExecution`). The served-override filter knew only a SOLE shipper; with two shippers it kept the override row's pair slot, which `lookupArtifactItem` enveloped with the name's first shipper. Now, for a flow or action name two or more packages ship, an item bound to a pair that declares any shipper's override is dropped from the pair slot (it is already served in its shipper's slot). Every other type keeps the pair's entry, as on `main` (`TWO_HOLDER_PAIR_SLOT_TYPES`). Judged by the one served-override predicate (`isServedOverrideRowOf`) against each shipper. A one-shipper name is narrowed exactly as before.
- **An action's override** (`declinesStoredRow` in `protocol-lock-state.ts`). An action row was judged as a declared override against `packagedArtifactOwner` only, the first holder to register, so the second holder's override was declined at its own address (`?package=`, plain and layered), in its served-overrides list, in the served list and in the execution view. It is now judged against every shipper, through the same helper the flow branch already used (`servedOverrideOfAShipper`). The six sealed types the same branch served (`page`, `app`, `dataset`, `doc`, `book`, `mapping`) keep `main`'s single-owner judgment: the code says so with its own return.
- **The boot pull** (`hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` + `incomingTakesStoredFlowSlot`). Which stored row holds a flow name's bare registry slot was settled against the bare-name owner only, so a package-less row read after the second holder's override took the slot and dropped it; the automation pull armed that holder's shipped body until `kernel:ready` re-armed. `incomingTakesStoredFlowSlot` now takes the set of shipping packages (the owner plus `shippedArtifactsOf`), and a row is an override when it declares any of them.

### FROM → TO

| # | case | FROM (`main`) | TO |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | flow, alpha registered first, env-wide list / execution view | `alpha:OVR-A` ×2, `alpha:OVR-B`, `beta:OVR-B` | `alpha:OVR-A`, `beta:OVR-B` |
| 2 | flow, beta registered first | `alpha:OVR-A`, `beta:OVR-A`, `beta:OVR-B` ×2 | `alpha:OVR-A`, `beta:OVR-B` |
| 3 | action, alpha first, lists | `alpha:OVR-A` ×2, `beta:SHIPPED-beta` | `alpha:OVR-A`, `beta:OVR-B` |
| 4 | action, beta first, lists | `alpha:SHIPPED-alpha`, `beta:OVR-B` ×2 | `alpha:OVR-A`, `beta:OVR-B` |
| 5 | action, the second holder's own address (`?package=`, plain and layered) and its served-overrides list | its shipped action | its declared override |
| 6 | one holder disabled (either one), lists | the disabled holder's override kept; for an action the enabled second holder's override declined | the enabled holder's own override alone |
| 7 | boot pull, the second holder's override then a package-less row | the package-less row takes the slot; the holder's shipped body armed until `kernel:ready` | each holder's own override armed from the first pull |

Unchanged, pinned as CONTROLs: one package ships the name with its declared override (listed once, as before); two packages ship the name and neither is overridden (each shipped body once); a pair row declaring a package that does not ship the name is no override. The flow's by-name reads (`?package=`) already answered each package's own override and are unchanged.

**Clause-②: `no (narrowing)`**: the env-wide lists stop serving the extra misattributed entries; for an action, the decline this replaces was never the contract (ADR-0150 D4 binds each `.custom` override to the package it customizes). First-party callers that read those entries: 0. **Metadata-protocol: `none`**: no authorable key, value, type or stored shape moves.

### Carried, not here

- **#33131**: the six sealed types' two-holder judgment; the env-wide list entries of every other overlay type under a name two packages ship; and the action registry face. The hydrator registers an action's pair row under the bare name wearing the first shipper's envelope, so a registry reader (`getArtifactItem`) gets the first shipper's composite. Measured with the mixed pin: alpha registered first, only beta overridden, the action lists show `alpha:OVR-B` beside `beta:OVR-B`. With `main`'s owner-only action judgment put back, they show `alpha:OVR-B` beside `beta:SHIPPED-beta`, so the leak into the first holder's slot is `main`'s, not this change's. This change fixes the overridden holder's own slot and address. The seat recorded the case on #33131.
- **#32859**: the census twin (its own card).

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-flow-custom-override.test.ts`, `[#32613]` describe: both registration orders × flow (served list and execution view), action (served list, execution view and each package's address), and one holder disabled then re-enabled (each holder in turn), all expecting exactly `alpha:OVR-A` and `beta:OVR-B` (or the enabled holder's alone); CONTROLs: one shipper with its override; two shippers, no override.
- Same file, mixed case (review n1), both registration orders × either holder overridden: flow lists exactly the overridden holder's override and the other holder's shipped body, each at its own address; action lists the overridden holder's override in its own slot and serves it at its own address (the other holder's slot is carried, above).
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/stored-flow-slot.test.ts`, `[#32613]` describe (4): the second holder's override keeps the slot over a package-less row read after it and carries it; FROM pin (judged against the first holder alone, the package-less row took the slot); two holders' overrides in either order; CONTROL: a pair row declaring a non-shipper is no override.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-declared-override-first-boot-pull.integration.test.ts`: `[#32613]` rows in each order, the second package registered in each position: each holder's own body at the first pull.

<details><summary>Ablations, read on round-1 head c0b7cb13; the mutated lines keep their purpose on this head (fix committed first; scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; each leg rebuilt @objectstack/metadata-protocol; each restore verified: blob equal to HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

On head `c0b7cb13`:

- A, `protocol-lock-state.ts`: an action row judged against `packagedArtifactOwner` alone (the FROM): objectql `[#32613]` 4 failed, 4 passed (every action case, both orders, incl. disable/re-enable; the flow cases and CONTROLs stay green). Quote: `served: expected [...] to deeply equal [...]` `- "com.probe.beta:OVR-B"` `+ "com.probe.beta:SHIPPED-beta"`.
- B, `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`: keep the pair slot under two shippers (`return true || ...`): 6 failed, 2 passed (every two-holder case; the two CONTROLs stay green). Quote: `served: expected [ 'com.probe.alpha:OVR-A', …(3) ] to deeply equal [ 'com.probe.alpha:OVR-A', …(1) ]` `+ "com.probe.alpha:OVR-A"` `+ "com.probe.alpha:OVR-B"`.
- C, `protocol-registry-hydration.ts`: the slot settled against the owner alone (`shippingPackageIds(...)` emptied): service-automation `[#32613]` 2 failed, 4 passed (exactly the two package-less-row-after cases). Quote: `- "com.acme.other": "OTHER-OVERRIDE"` `+ "com.acme.other": "OTHER"`.
- Restore leg: rebuild exit 0; `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` exit 0 for all three markers; objectql `[#32613]` 8 passed, service-automation `[#32613]` 6 passed.
- For A and B the present-marker dist preflight answered exit 1: the bundler drops an inline comment inside an expression, so the marker could not be read in `dist/`; the red after the rebuild is what shows the mutated code ran. C's marker was read (exit 0).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Branch history.** The work began on `claude/project-thread-70eqr9` (server seat), continued on `claude/project-thread-63cajz`, and resumes here from `63cajz@b777b1b5`; every step merged `origin/main`, none rebased. Earlier branches are left as pushed.
- **Order.** Lands after #32568 (PR #32741, merged) and before #32552; #32820 shares `protocol-registry-hydration.ts` and runs after this lands.
